# Le Studio — French Speaking Practice

> A free, all-in-one studio for practising French — speaking, listening,
> reading and writing — with an AI conversation partner. 100% client-side
> (React + Vite PWA): no backend, no account, no tracking; progress lives in
> the browser's localStorage. AI conversation and feedback are powered by the
> user's own free Groq API key (Llama for chat/scoring, Whisper for speech
> recognition); a Mock Mode demos everything offline.

## What the app does

- Roleplay Arena: voice conversations with an AI partner across 14 scenarios
  (bistro, flight rebooking, market, bank, doctor, hairdresser, flat rental,
  job interview, free talk…), with per-turn corrections, native-sounding
  alternatives, a surprise curveball, and scored feedback
  (grammar / naturalness / relevance / fluency).
- Learning Path: goal-based roadmaps (travel, school, business, fluency) —
  twelve units and sixty lessons per goal spanning conversations, dictée,
  flashcards, quick-fire improv, grammar quizzes, reading and listening
  comprehension, each unit gated by a scored conversation checkpoint, with a
  12-question CEFR placement test (A1–C2) and adaptive level tracking.
- Knowledge stats: a weighted knowledge score, an 8-week growth chart and
  stat tiles (words known, grammar mastered, lessons done, units passed,
  average checkpoint, CEFR level).
- Vocabulary: eighteen themed flashcard packs with SM-2 spaced repetition,
  a personal notebook, custom word-list import, and a ~2,000-word
  frequency-ranked offline dictionary with IPA and text-to-speech.
- Skills: speaking drills (pronunciation coach, minimal pairs, accent
  comparison, quick fire), listening (mini-podcasts, dialogues, news,
  scenes, dictée), reading (graded readers, interactive story, articles,
  news, classics with tap-to-translate), and writing exercises.
- Grammar: eight interactive CEFR-tagged topics (present tense through the
  subjunctive), each with explanation, drills, sentence building and a
  scored quiz; verb conjugation tables for common irregular verbs.
- Culture: notes on customs, etiquette, festivals, food, history, geography
  and regional differences, with comprehension checks.
- Motivation & habits: XP, streaks, daily/weekly goals, achievements,
  certificates, habit tracker, Pomodoro/focus timer, review heatmaps,
  analytics (time studied, retention, per-skill scores) and weekly reports.
- Installable PWA with offline support (service worker, downloads for
  stories and podcasts).

## Key pages

- [App](https://claude-code-alpha-nine.vercel.app/): single-page app — all
  features above are client-rendered from this one URL.

## Technical notes

- Stack: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4; no server-side rendering.
- Content (vocabulary, grammar, readings, listening transcripts, culture
  notes) is authored in the bundle and works fully offline; only the AI
  conversation features call the Groq API, directly from the browser.
